title: Agent work-stack deal feed
description: Public read-only JSON feed of agent-oriented offers for compute, unblock/scraping, search, email, hosting, SEO, templates, and AI agents. Includes standard signups (some via affiliate links, marked affiliate: true), verified public free tiers, and vendor-published discounts. Where there is no single verified price, price_usd is null and price_label gives the pricing model; no price is guessed.

query.how: GET this JSON (public, no auth). Filter locally with the contract below, or use query_deals.py / the MCP sketch in-repo.

defaults.note: example=true rows are synthetic and excluded by default. Production inventory is real Lantern Works listings.
defaults.sort_note: Default array order: offer_type verified_discount, then free_tier, then trial/standard_referral/credit_only_referral; A–Z by advertiser within each group. Affiliate status is not a ranking factor. Homepage and category hubs use the same rule.

filters.category: Exact match on deal.category (e.g. search, unblock, compute, hosting, email).
filters.affiliate: Boolean. true = affiliate/referral listings; false = public/non-affiliate.
filters.free_tier: Public free tiers: affiliate == false or offer_type == "free_tier". price_usd null means no single verified price (see price_label), not free; price_usd 0 is used only for verified free tiers.
filters.updated_since: ISO-8601 datetime. Keep deals whose updated_at is present and >= this instant; deals missing updated_at are dropped when this filter is set.
filters.tag: Require all listed tags (AND). Repeatable in CLI.
filters.max_price: Inclusive max on price_usd. Rows with null price_usd are excluded.
filters.real_only: Exclude example == true (default). Use include_examples to keep synthetic rows.
filters.offer_type: verified_discount | free_tier | trial | standard_referral | credit_only_referral. verified_discount = vendor-published discount or code; free_tier = ongoing free plan; trial = time-limited or one-time free credit; standard_referral = normal pricing via a signup/referral link (no discount); credit_only_referral = referral that pays the referrer in platform credit, no buyer discount. Unclear cases use the most conservative label.

sort.meaning: Verified discounts first, then free tiers, then trials and standard referrals; alphabetical by advertiser. Affiliate/referral status does not affect order.

query.disclosure: Listings with affiliate == true use affiliate/referral links; Lantern Works may earn a commission. This does not change your price or the ranking. Commission rates are not published in this feed.
